name: github-action
title: GitHub Action
blurb: Zero-dependency JavaScript action: pure counting, Markdown step summary, GITHUB_OUTPUT, node:test suite that spawns the real entry point
default_description: A GitHub Action that measures files.
next_steps: git add . && git commit -m 'Add action' && git push

verify.name: run
verify.cmd: out=$(mktemp) && sum=$(mktemp) && INPUT_PATHS='README.md,package.json' GITHUB_OUTPUT=$out GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=$sum node src/index.js >/dev/null && cat $out && grep -q '^lines=' $out && grep -q '^### ' $sum; status=$?; rm -f $out $sum; exit $status
